# zip

Create ZIP archives containing files and directories.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/zip -qr bundle.zip documents
moonx cli/zip -q0 bundle.zip image.png
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-r` | Include directory contents recursively. |
| `-q` | Suppress progress messages. |
| `-0` | Store entries without compression. |
| `-1` | Use Deflate compression level 1. |
| `-2` | Use Deflate compression level 2. |
| `-3` | Use Deflate compression level 3. |
| `-4` | Use Deflate compression level 4. |
| `-5` | Use Deflate compression level 5. |
| `-6` | Use Deflate compression level 6. |
| `-7` | Use Deflate compression level 7. |
| `-8` | Use Deflate compression level 8. |
| `-9` | Use Deflate compression level 9. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
| `-T` | Verify an existing or newly created archive. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

New archive names acquire a .zip extension when the final component has no extension. Use - for an archive on stdout. Creation accepts portable relative names and rejects existing output archives and links. Stored entries use synthetic ZIP timestamps and omit host ownership. The in-memory archive and total payload limit is 64 MiB, with up to 65,535 members.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md).
